metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: GOJWUY crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C192 H181 Er26 N41 O135 2+,C6 H4 N1 O2 1-,18(H2 O1),I1 1-. From the CIF bond table, Er1 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er2 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er3 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er4 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er5 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er6 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er7 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er8 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er9 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er10 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er11 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er12 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er13 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er14 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er15 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er16 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er17 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er18 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er19 (Er) has 9 O neighbors; Er20 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er21 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er22 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er23 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er24 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er25 (Er) has 8 O neighbors; Er26 (Er) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 54 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.640-4.277 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 99.23-125.00°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula Er26I(μ3-OH)20(μ3-O)6(NO3)9(IN)33(OH)3(H2O)33; analytical formula C198H221Er26IN42O155. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 20 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 μ3-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 9 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 3 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 33 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
